services_cells.parquet.geometry: centre point of a 250 m EPSG:2180 cell (cell_id = E<x0>N<y0>)
services_cells.parquet.rows: populated FUA cells inside the GTFS coverage mask (all feeds)
services_cells.parquet.t_*: minutes to the nearest facility, null = none within 60 min; pt = median over departures each minute in the window, never worse than walking

note: travel time to nearest facility per covered origin cell (R5, min over facility points); age groups from NSP 2021 1 km grid disaggregated to 250 m (pipeline.agegrid)
